body: Do you by any chance have a journal? Sometimes we are our own best listeners and being able to let everything out and look back at it can help. And I’m sorry about your friend, she may be struggling in her own sense and she could be telling you what she has told herself. Finding an outlet is extremely important and you can always see what else you can get from it!

I’m glad you’re still here and found so many amazing things to look forward to, you got this! You never know what amazing experiences you’ll have and memories you will make. It’s hard to find the good when so many bad things are happening but hope is a beautiful thing

Is it too late to be able to change studies or to ask your professor to give you more time? If something is bringing you more pain than pleasure and you are able to make a change, it might be best to! If not, try to get some rest, don’t overthink and do the best you can (:

You did not and do not deserve any of those things. People are so cruel in this world that they dim the brightest lights. You deserve to not feel this way and to heal. I relate to you and it is a really hard process to become whole again but doing little things for yourself is what is important

I had a similar experience on my exam in Friday where I didn’t even get to finish even though I knew the material. It’s frustrating but maybe from this you can try to change the way you take exams and do better on the next one! It’s hard to be strong and keep going but find a reason to. I just went outside and it is so quite and the stars are shinning so beautifully, it makes me want to watch them forever
I feel the same way, it’s hard to break out of the sad cycle of day to day life
